Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_EnableMod_too: Master switch. If off, the mod does nothing at all: no capture, no logging, no spawn menu.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_EnableSpawnMe: Adds "SCLG Spawn Test" to the right-click ground menu for admins/moderators, with preset zombie templates to reproduce the loot-loss bug on demand.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_EnableFileLog: Writes SiKCorpseLootGuard_losses.log, _summary.log and _spawns.log to the server's Zomboid/Lua/ folder. Turn off to keep console-only output.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_EnableConsole: Prints LOSS/WARN/INFO lines to the server console. Turn off to keep file-only output (if file logging is enabled).
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_EnablePostAni: Re-checks the corpse's items again a few seconds after it settles on the ground, to catch losses that happen after the death animation finishes (not just at the moment of death).
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_PostAnimation: How long to wait after the corpse is created before comparing its items again.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_EnableNearbyP: When the post-death-animation recheck finds fewer items, checks if a player was close enough to have legitimately looted the corpse themselves. If so, logs it as informational instead of a loss, to avoid false positives from normal looting.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_EnableCapacit: Logs the corpse container's weight/capacity right after it's rebuilt, to test whether items could be silently dropped for exceeding a capacity limit rather than an instantiation failure.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_EnableDeathCo: Enable death context capture (weapon, animation state)

Records the weapon used in the last hit and the zombie's crawling/fallen state at death, included in loss log lines, to help spot whether a specific weapon type or death animation correlates with the bug.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_EnableAuthent: When a zombie was visually wearing Authentic Z clothing before dying, tries to instantiate those items the same way the game's corpse rebuild does, to test whether they fail to create (a real engine error seen with Authentic Z items). Confirms or rules out Authentic Z as the cause of the loot-loss bug with real data.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_EnableFallbac: Samples zombie state periodically as a backup capture path, for deaths that don't go through a weapon hit (fire, falls, etc). Has a performance cost with many zombies on screen; turn off if you only care about melee/firearm deaths.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_ZombieUpdateS: Fallback sample rate (1 in N updates)
OnZombieUpdate fires per zombie per tick. Only 1 in N calls is processed. Lower = more accurate fallback capture but higher performance cost.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_SummaryInterv: How often the accumulated-stats summary line is printed/written.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_VerboseDebug_: Also logs zombies WITHOUT losses (captures, cache sweeps, etc). Very noisy, only for debugging the mod itself.
Sandbox_SiKCorpseLootGuard_ClientVisualS: How often (seconds) each client scans nearby zombies for a fallback visual report, for deaths without a weapon hit (fire, vehicle...). Lower = more up to date, more network traffic.
Only zombies within this distance from the player are sampled by the periodic fallback scan.
Client visual scan budget per sweep
Max number of new zombies reported per periodic scan - keeps network traffic bounded when many zombies are nearby at once.
